content.short: GrinderWiki is an all-in-one hub for tracking and exploring daily and ongoing quests and potential airdrops across Web3 verticals, including L1, L2, Gaming, and DeFi.
content.description: GrinderWiki serves as a comprehensive hub for tracking and exploring daily and ongoing quests, as well as potential airdrops, across the Web3 ecosystem—from L1 and L2 networks to Gaming and DeFi. Built by two engineers, Nftdefiog and Silhom, the platform aggregates quests from leading questing platforms, enabling users to discover emerging Web3 projects and earn rewards. With clear navigation and up-to-date listings, GrinderWiki helps explorers and builders stay informed about opportunities across multiple chains and layers.
content.meta: GrinderWiki tracks and explores daily and ongoing quests and potential airdrops in Web3. Discover GrinderWiki and other DeFi Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
